game.title: Pico-Clinic
title.subtitle: The drone micro-surgery workshop
op.hint.unscrew: Put your finger on a screw, then circle around it to unscrew it.
op.hint.rusty: Rusty screw: keep turning a little longer!
op.hint.connector: The connector is unplugged. Drag the plug to its socket.
done.title: Fixed!
op.hint.chip_remove: The chip is fried! Grab it and pull it off the green board.
op.hint.chip_drag_old: Take it off the green board, then let go.
op.hint.chip_place: Take the new chip from the box at the top right and set it on the frame.
op.hint.chip_drag_new: Aim for the frame: let go when it turns bright white.
op.hint.solder: The track is cut. Put your finger on the blinking pad to pick up the iron.
op.hint.heating: The iron is heating up… hold still!
op.hint.trace: Follow the path to the other pad without lifting your finger.
op.chip_off_board: Take it all the way off the board!
op.chip_miss: Not quite… aim for the frame.
op.too_early: Wait for the iron to heat up!
op.break: Finger lifted: start again from the pad.
op.hint.diag: Diagnosis! Put your finger on the board: a magnifier appears. Move it around to find hidden faults.
op.hint.diag_move: Move the magnifier over the parts of the board.
op.hint.vacuum: The vacuum follows your finger, just above it. Rub quickly and avoid the circled capacitors!
op.hint.rust_left: Still some rust: rub it with your finger to vacuum it, or press Start.
op.fragile_broken: Ouch! Broken capacitor: you'll have to buy a new one.
done.already_paid: Order already paid: replay for 3 stars!
op.hint.rust: Rust (brown spots)! Rub it quickly with your finger: the vacuum appears just above it. Avoid the blue capacitors.
op.hint.cap_remove: A capacitor is broken: the drone won't start. Grab it and take it off the board.
op.hint.cap_place: Take a new capacitor (next to the box) and put it on a blinking spot.
op.hint.cap_drag_new: Drop it on the blinking spot.
op.cap_miss: Not quite… aim for the spot.
op.hint.cap_drag_old: Take it off the green board, then let go.
orders.title: Orders
orders.need_stars: Exam: you need {n} stars (you have {s}). Replay some orders!
shop.title: Shop
tool.laser.desc: Very wide path, burns even more slowly
tool.vacuum_pump.desc: Cleans an area twice as wide
tool.scanner.desc: Shows every fault as soon as you open up
tool.tweezers_fine.desc: Chips and capacitors snap in more easily
done.need_stars: Next order: exam at {n} stars (you have {s})
arc.lea.1.intro: Hello... my drone won't work. Dad says it's too old.
arc.lea.1.thanks: It flies! Thank you so much!
arc.passage.2.intro: My drone spent the winter at the back of the garage. Look at all this rust!
arc.passage.3.intro: My dog chewed a cable. Since then it won't fly at all.
arc.passage.3.thanks: It flies! I'll keep it on a higher shelf, promise.
arc.passage.4.intro: It went "pfff" and a little smoke came out. It smells burnt!
arc.passage.4.thanks: No more burnt smell! It's like magic.
arc.passage.5.intro: It won't start and I can't see anything broken. Can you take a look?
arc.passage.5.thanks: Two hidden faults? Good thing you have a magnifier!
arc.passage.6.intro: My dragonfly fell into a puddle. She creaks when she flaps her wings.
arc.passage.6.thanks: She's twirling! Thank you, thank you!
arc.volute.7.intro: My scarab Auguste, a darling! His wing cases have been dragging for a week.
arc.volute.7.thanks: Auguste is flying! You have fairy fingers. I'll be back, you can count on me.
arc.turbo.8.intro: Ten minutes before the race! Can you do it in five?
arc.turbo.8.thanks: You're the best! I owe you a win.
arc.lea.9.intro: This is Pantoufle. Grandma gave him to me. He doesn't purr anymore.
arc.ampere.10.intro: I... built this. I think. I lost the plans.
arc.ampere.10.thanks: Extraordinary! How did you guess? You remind me of someone.
counter.title: Counter
counter.exam_line: Rank {r} exam, boss! Every star counts here. Even one is enough to pass.
orders.gribouille_stars: To open the exam we need {n} stars, boss. We have {s}. Let's replay old orders to earn the missing ones!
nb.title: Master Ohm's notebook
nb.parts_hint: Never sold: they must be earned.
nb.use.proto: Needed for the prototype of order {n}
rank.1.unlocks: Simple toy drones, screwdriver and basic iron
rank.2.unlocks: Cyber insects, strong vacuum, precision iron, Pantoufle
rank.3.unlocks: Mechanical mascots, thermal magnifier, fine tweezers
rank.4.unlocks: Pro and race drones, laser, magnetic pump, antistatic tweezers
client.lea.bio: A shy little girl. Her robot plush Pantoufle was made by her grandmother.
client.volute.bio: A chatty collector of mechanical insects. She names every one of them and is preparing a big exhibition.
client.turbo.bio: A drone racer, hasty and boastful, but a good loser. His rival is called Zephyr.
client.ampere.bio: An absent-minded inventor who always loses his plans. He seems to have known Master Ohm...
client.brindille.bio: An overworked neighborhood courier. His little drone fleet breaks down every week.
client.quartz.bio: The serious, demanding director of a large robot clinic.
rankup.title: New rank!
rankup.gribouille: Well done, boss! The workshop is growing. Master Ohm would be proud.
